section_12_gate_analysis_ADDED_POST_HOC_.why_the_qualitative_pattern_did_not_matc: M9.5's own disjoint support=4 subset (16 physical incidents for golden-reference, same nominal size as M9.4's calibration_m9_4) calibrated WELL (ARM_A 0.91-0.93, ARM_B2 0.87-0.96 across all trained families), unlike M9.4's specific draw (ARM_A 0.60-0.68).
